comments: A short biography from the Shel dkar chos 'byung is translated in [N35FPQ6L]: 62-70. It gives a fire-male-mouse year (1276) as birth-date, and Gyam in Zur rtso as its birthplace. He took novice vows when he was five years old at 'Brog rdo gling, and was ordained at seven.
